findings.reason: The `retryCount > 1` OR branch really has no method filter, but only this SMS cron increments retryCount, so nothing is affected today and the harm needs other crons to start counting retries later.

Verified: the new `prisma.workflowReminder.update` in the catch block is not guarded, so a P2025 or DB error there (for example a reminder deleted mid-run) now rejects the handler and skips the rest of the batch, which the old log-only catch did not do; this is real but needs an uncommon race.

Verified that the cron runs every 15 minutes and that `scheduleSMS` returns undefined for locked users or teams, so two failed runs get a reminder deleted with no log; this is a real behaviour change, but the cap looks intentional, so it deserves a comment rather than a block.
